about.title: About
about.intro: Background of Yoann Barbier, freelance full-stack developer based in Nantes, France: over 15 years of experience with React, TypeScript and Node.js.
about.lead: As a freelance full-stack developer based in Nantes, I help companies and product teams design, architect and evolve modern web applications.
summary: Based in Nantes, available remotely or on site depending on the project.
approach: I work mainly with JavaScript and TypeScript, with particular attention to code quality, performance and the robustness of the solutions.
My work covers architecture, good practices, testing, continuous integration and CI/CD pipelines, in collaboration with product and design teams.

experience.summary: Front-end and full-stack expertise around React.js, TypeScript and Node.js: architecture, performance, good practices, continuous integration, testing and CI/CD pipelines, in collaboration with product and design teams.
Technical lead on SaaS, web and mobile projects: team supervision, technology choices, architecture, development, performance, scalability, CI/CD and mentoring.
experience.stack: Angular, React, React Native, Vue / Nuxt, Node.js, NestJS, TypeORM, GitLab CI

experience.summary: Technical leadership and design of the myKeople SaaS platform, an online HR tool: MEAN architecture, product development from prototype to a scalable version, microservices, Socket.IO, in-memory caching, load balancing, PDF generation and team management.
User interfaces for a satellite set-top box: 3D UI, TV guide, VOD, media player, interactive components, middleware and remote debugging.
Projects for large corporate clients: redesign of business applications, front-end development, ExtJS upgrades, technical supervision and continuous integration.

about.education: Degree from Polytech'Nantes, Software Systems and Networks major ("Système Informatique Logicielle et Réseaux"), 2008.
